class.name: MaszynaE3DModelReader
class.brief_description: Reads a model file apart as its description and its geometry.
class.description: A model file ([code].e3d[/code], [code].t3d[/code]) read by its extension's parser. What a vehicle's data needs of its model - the submodels its MMD names - is its description alone ([method read_description]), with nothing of it in the GPU; only a model drawn gets its geometry ([method read_geometry], [method MaszynaE3DModel.apply_geometry]). A pure helper; the models are kept by [code]MaszynaE3DModelManager[/code].

method.name: read_description
method.description: Returns the description of the model file at [param path] - its submodels, their names, transforms and skins, its lights - without its geometry: no mesh, nothing in the GPU. Of an [code].e3d[/code] the vertex and index chunks are skipped unread. Null when it cannot be read.

method.name: read_geometry
method.description: Returns the geometry of the model file at [param path], to be applied to its description; null when it cannot be read.

method.name: read_model
method.description: Returns the model to draw of the file at [param path]: its description with its geometry applied - its meshes in the GPU; null when it cannot be read.

method.name: read_submodel_positions
method.description: Returns the vertices of the submodel of geometry index [param index] in the model file at [param path], in the submodel's own frame; of an [code].e3d[/code] only they are read of the vertex chunk.
